## B1. Tell me about a time you found a mistake others had missed.
- Round: r2
- Kind: behavioural
- Source: reported
- Stories: S1
- Route: Context → Action → Result → Lesson
- Outline: treasurer, payments sheet; wrote a script; 12 duplicates found

### Model answer

When I was treasurer of our investing society, I kept the membership payments in a spreadsheet by hand. PRACTICE VERSION: how long it took each month. I wrote a short script to match the bank export against the sheet and found 12 payments recorded twice. We refunded them and now reconcile every month.
